lines.en: I bump into Ayane when I make my way over to the pool.
lines.zh: 我去泳池那边的时候撞见了 Ayane。

lines.en: I guess I use the term {i}bump{/i} lightly though, as I was kind of hoping she'd be here.
lines.zh: 不过我用「{i}撞见{/i}」这个词算是轻描淡写——因为我其实挺希望她在这儿的。

lines.en: Talking to anyone else nowadays just feels like I'm forcing myself most of the time.
lines.zh: 如今跟别的任何人说话，大多时候都像是在强迫自己。

lines.en: Things aren't perfect with Ayane and me. They haven't been since that night on the roof. But she's closer to understanding than anyone else what I'm going through.
lines.zh: 我和 Ayane 之间并不完美。从屋顶那一夜之后就没完美过。但她比其他任何人都更接近理解我在经历什么。

lines.en: And the reason for that's simple. It's because {i}she's{/i} going through it as well. And the fact that she's able to smile in spite of that makes her ten times stronger than I am.
lines.zh: 而原因很简单。因为{i}她{/i}也在经历同样的事。而她在这种情况下还能笑得出来，这一点让她比我强十倍。

lines.en: I wish I could match her pace and her color and all of the things that make her who she is.
lines.zh: 我希望自己能跟上她的步调、她的色彩，以及所有构成「她之所以是她」的那些东西。

lines.en: But a quick glance at the water and the rippled reflection of a broken man staring back at me tells me it's impossible.
lines.zh: 可匆匆瞥一眼水面、看见那道倒映回来的破碎男人的涟漪，我就知道不可能。

lines.en: And I decide against plaguing her smile with one that would be little more than avian mimicry.
lines.zh: 于是我决定不用一个充其量只是鸟类模仿的笑容去污染她的笑。

lines.en: She gets back into the water and speaks to me from there.
lines.zh: 她回到水里，从那儿跟我说话。

lines.en: When she goes under, she closes her eyes.
lines.zh: 她潜下去的时候，会闭上眼睛。

lines.en: And I think something like that might feel okay if I can hold it until the light is gone.
lines.zh: 而我想，如果我能把它一直保持到光消失，那样的事也许会感觉还不错。
